Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring the disclosure to potential borrowers of alternatives to a small loan.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to alternatives to a small loan; and adding a newsection to chapter 31.45 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 31.45 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) In addition to any other disclosure required under this chapteror by state or federal law, a licensee with a small loan endorsementmust provide a disclosure statement that informs a potential borrowerthat possible alternatives to a small loan exist and that the borrowermay qualify for other assistance or loans. The statement must: (a) Be a separate document; (b) Be in at least twelvepoint type; (c) Be provided to the potential borrower along with or prior to anapplication; (d) Provide examples of possible alternatives and contactinformation, including: (i) The army emergency relief program; (ii) The navymarine corps relief society quick assist loanprogram; p. 1 HB 1851 (iii) The air force aid society falcon loan program; (iv) The coast guard mutual assistance program; (v) The diversion cash assistance program offered by the departmentof social and health services; and (vi) Other alternatives required by the director; (e) Provide a list of independent financial counseling agencies inthe area or region; and (f) Be approved by the director prior to use. If the directorlater withdraws approval, the licensee must cease using the disapprovedstatement. (2) The director may adopt rules to implement this section.
